content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text decides the Isaiah 7:14 link by noting that 'the sign itself does not state the mechanism,' which is a verse-level stating-verse assessment of a pressed link.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"the sign itself does not state the mechanism.","rule_words":"the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires","room":"'never verse by verse': I weighed whether it allows the judge to note what a single sign verse does not state, versus requiring the judge to weigh the pressed verses as a chain by footing rather than by a lone verse's non-statement.","why":"Because the judge marks the link underdetermined from the sign verse's own failure to state the mechanism, it uses the retired stating-verse approach instead of weighing chain against chain by footing."}
